name: EPIC 249620395
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 15, 18.8 solar radii and 0.87 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 249620395 (K2 campaign 15): PARAM radius (solar radii) 18.828446 (16th-84th percentiles 17.957559-19.780775), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 249620395: GALAH DR3 effective temperature 4690.975 +/- 123 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

text.card: A red giant 6,625 parsecs away, 19 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 0.87 solar masses and 18.8 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,691 K at its surface.
